{"metadata":{"description":"Workspace-scoped Python virtual environment management for a DeepSeek Harness project — discover, create, install into, and remove virtual environments without sandbox, network, or subprocess pitfalls.","id":"gh:1335843541","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-python-env","slug":"AngelosZou/dsh-python-env","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Workspace-scoped Python virtual environment management for a DeepSeek Harness project — discover, cr"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"eate, install into, and remove virtual environments without sandbox, network, or subprocess pitfalls"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ate, install into, and remove virtual environments without sandbox, network, or subprocess pitfalls."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-python-env"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Workspace-scoped Python virtual environment management for a DeepSeek Harness project — discover, "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"create, install into, and remove virtual environments without sandbox, network, or subprocess pitfal"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ate, install into, and remove virtual environments without sandbox, network, or subprocess pitfalls."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives one project (workspace) agent-facing Python virtual environment"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"arness plugin that gives one project (workspace) agent-facing Python virtual environment management:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Five model tools** — `pyenv_discover`, `pyenv_create`, `pyenv_install`, `pyenv_uninstall`, `pyen"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"v_remove` — plus the `python-env` skill and a system-prompt guidance section.
- Runs the **standard "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"library** `python -m venv` / `pip` through the platform **subprocess channel** (host process) instea"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"d of the sandboxed shell, so venv creation, `ensurepip` bootstrapping, and package-index network acc"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ess work where shell-side pip fails.
- **Mirror and proxy fallback** — on a network-classified failu"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"re, installs retry across PyPI mirrors (TUNA, Aliyun, USTC) and probe common local proxy ports; `ind"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ex` / `proxy` arguments pin either.
- **Workspace confinement** — every path resolves inside the ses"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"sion workspace (case-insensitive on Windows); caches and temp state live under `<workspace>/.dsh-pye"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"nv/`; commands are argv arrays (no shell); the global Python environment, host pip cache, and system"},{"id":"p6s10","text":" temp are never touched.
- **Cross-platform** — Windows / macOS / Linux layouts and interpreter chai"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"ns (`Scripts` vs `bin`, `py -3` vs `python3`).
- **No third-party dependency** — no uv, no virtualen"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"v, no other plugin. A pip-less environment is repaired offline via `ensurepip`.
- **Session policy p"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"arity** — the mutating tools consult the session's sandbox policy and refuse to run in read-only ses"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"sions; discovery stays available everywhere."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- Node.js >= 20
- A DSH profile composed from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` (it provides the `subprocess`,"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" `jobs`, `tools`, and `skills` services the plugin uses)
- Python >= 3.8 (on PATH, or passed explici"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"tly) — only for the environments the plugin manages"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"From npm:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"From a local checkout (development):"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Then **restart the DSH backend** — the host composition loads at process start. The tools appear in "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"new sessions: `pyenv_discover`, `pyenv_create`, `pyenv_install`, `pyenv_uninstall`, `pyenv_remove`, "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"plus the `python-env` skill."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Agent side:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `pyenv_discover` | Find environments up to two levels deep by the `pyvenv.cfg` marker or conventio"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"nal names (`.venv`, `venv`, `env`, `.env`, `virtualenv`); report path, interpreter, version, pip ava"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ilability. |
| `pyenv_create` | Create an environment with `python -m venv` — `name` / `root_dir` / "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"base `python` arguments, idempotent on existing environments. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Subprocess channel** — the DSH shell sandbox blocks CPython's owner-only temp directories (Windo"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ws `[Errno 13]` during `ensurepip`/wheel unpacking) and package-index network access. Plugin code ru"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ns in the host process, so every python/pip/venv invocation goes through `ctx.subprocess` (the same "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"channel the graphlint plugin uses) with argv arrays, byte-capped collected output, and tree-scoped t"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ermination. The unrestricted token is compensated by the confinement model below — not by weakening "},{"id":"p20s6","text":"the sandbox.
- **Confinement** — every model-influenced path passes `guardWorkspacePath` (absolute r"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"esolution + containment, `..`-safe); venv names are single-segment regex-validated and re-guarded af"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"ter `join`; children get `PIP_CACHE_DIR` / TMP / TEMP / TMPDIR re-pointed into `<workspace>/.dsh-pye"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"nv/`.
- **Install attempt chain** — default index first; a network-classified failure (connection re"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"set/timeout/DNS — never "No matching distribution found" or TLS errors) falls back across TUNA → Ali"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"yun → USTC mirrors and, once, probes common local proxy ports (7890, 7891, 10809, 10808, 8888) to re"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"try the same index through a live one.
- **ensurepip repair** — `<venv-python> -m ensurepip --upgrad"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"e` bootstraps pip offline from bundled wheels; when ensurepip itself is absent the error carries the"},{"id":"p20s14","text":" Debian/Ubuntu `python3-venv` hint.
- **Concurrency** — mutating tools declare `isConcurrencySafe: f"},{"id":"p20s15","text":"alse`, so the scheduler serializes them; discovery stays read-only.
- **Skill & guidance** — the `py"},{"id":"p20s16","text":"thon-env` skill teaches tool-first usage and the "never escalate for pip" rule; one system-prompt se"},{"id":"p20s17","text":"ction (`dsh-python-env:guidance`, order 120) reminds every session that the pyenv tools are the sanc"},{"id":"p20s18","text":"python-env:guidance`, order 120) reminds every session that the pyenv tools are the sanctioned path."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"When DSH also has the dsh-multi-folder plugin installed, the Agent can use the tools provided by dsh"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"-python-env to manage the secondary working directories specified by the user in dsh-multi-folder, e"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ven when those working directories are outside the main working directory. Environment management pe"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"rmissions for the secondary working directories are the same as for the main working directory; when"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" the Agent runs in Read Only mode, the tools refuse any operation. This compatibility is automatic a"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"nd optional — it takes effect automatically whenever both dsh-multi-folder and dsh-python-env are in"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"stalled in the DSH environment. If dsh-multi-folder is not installed, dsh-python-env's functionality"},{"id":"p22s8","text":" is unaffected. This compatibility introduces no additional performance burden or context overhead."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Installing packages means executing third-party code: `pyenv_install` (including the auto-created `."},{"id":"p24s2","text":"venv` path) downloads and runs code from the configured index with the host user's privileges, and e"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ditable installs import in-workspace projects as-is. The plugin mitigates this with HTTPS-only index"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"es, workspace-only blast radius (a compromised environment is disposable via `pyenv_remove`), full r"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"outing transparency, session policy parity (read-only sessions cannot trigger any of it), and per-pr"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ofile opt-in. See SECURITY.md for the complete threat model and mitigation list."}],"truncated":true}
